name: Thomson Medical Group Limited
summary: Thomson Medical Group Limited, an investment holding company, is engaged in operating hospitals and clinics and provision of healthcare services for women and children in Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The company owns and operates the Thomson Medical Centre, as well as a network of medical clinics and facilities. The company also offers urgent care services, such as basic resuscitation, ECG, vaccinations, IM/IV fluid and IV antibiotic administration, surgeries and procedures, wound care and stitching, and X-ray and basic laboratory tests; health screening services; services related to skin and aesthetics, and pain and rehab management; and herbal tea.
